Are you passionate about designing and building AI-powered applications that bring together large language models, agentic workflows, and full stack engineering to solve real business problems? If so, Tech@Lilly is looking for an AI Full Stack Engineer to design, build, and scale AI-powered applications and full stack solutions across the enterprise. 4468922949.description: Why Mobility Global? At Mobility Global, our mission is to provide the trusted information that helps billions of people build, sell, and own vehicles with confidence. As we shape the next generation of automotive intelligence through innovation, AI, and industry-leading data, we're creating new opportunities for our customers, our business, and our people. Join a team singularly focused on transforming the automotive industry. S&P Global Mobility is Mobility Global — the company behind CARFAX, automotiveMastermind, Market Scan, and Polk Automotive Solutions. Our strength comes from our people, and here, the progress you make helps the entire automotive ecosystem move faster and with greater confidence. The Team You will join the AI Engineering team at Mobility Global. We build the conversational analytics products, shared AI services, and agent platforms that sit on top of the industry’s deepest automotive dataset, and we build the internal tooling that drives AI adoption across the PDLC/SDLC, from requirements and design through code, testing, and release. We are a small, senior, product-minded team that owns its work end to end, from the React front end a customer touches through the FastAPI services and data layer behind it to the evaluation harnesses that tell us whether the answer was right. We work AI-natively by default: coding agents, agentic workflows, and LLM-assisted review are part of how the team ships every day, not a side experiment, and we care as much about engineering judgement as we do about raw output. This role is a deliberate early-career seat on that team, with senior engineers close by and real production ownership from the first quarter. Responsibilities And Impact Build LLM-powered features in Python — agentic workflows in LangGraph, retrieval and RAG pipelines, text-to-SQL, and tool/MCP integrations that reach real users rather than staying in a notebook. Ship the services behind them — write clean, typed, tested Python and FastAPI endpoints, including streaming responses, async I/O, and sensible error handling. Own evaluation and quality for what you build — assemble golden datasets, write eval and guardrail test suites, instrument traces, and use the results to decide whether a change actually helped. Do prompt and context engineering as an engineering discipline — iterate on prompts, tool schemas, and retrieval strategy, and measure the difference instead of guessing at it. Debug agent behaviour end to end — read traces, isolate failures across retrieval, tool calls, parsing, and entitlements, and turn each one into a regression test. Work daily with AI coding agents and with the people around you — use agents to move faster while reviewing their output carefully, and pair with senior engineers, data scientists, and product partners to learn the domain quickly. What We’re Looking For Basic Required Qualifications: 1 to 5 years of professional software engineering experience, with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong Python fundamentals — comfortable with async, type hints, testing, and packaging, and able to write code that another engineer can read and maintain. Hands-on experience building LLM applications — LangGraph or a comparable orchestration framework (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or an agent SDK), plus prompt engineering and retrieval/RAG patterns, demonstrated through professional work, internships, or substantial personal projects. Working knowledge of SQL and the data layer behind AI systems — relational databases and at least one vector store, including embeddings, chunking, and basic query tuning — together with REST API development, ideally in FastAPI. Fluent daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar) as part of how you actually build, not as an occasional experiment. Clear written and verbal communication — can explain what you built, what you tried, and what did not work, to both technical and non-technical colleagues. Genuine curiosity and speed of learning — keeps up with a field that changes monthly and brings what you find back to the team. Ownership and healthy scepticism — follows a problem through to a verified fix, and checks AI-generated output rather than trusting it by default. Collaborative and coachable — asks for help early, takes review feedback well, and works comfortably across time zones in a distributed team. Additional Preferred Qualifications Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tooling — LangFuse, OpenTelemetry, Ragas, DeepEval, or an in-house equivalent. Exposure to agent protocols and multi-agent patterns — MCP servers and tooling, agent SDKs, orchestration and hand-off design, or human-in-the-loop workflows. Cloud and delivery basics on AWS — containerised deployment, serverless, CI/CD, and an eye on latency and token cost. Front-end familiarity — React or Angular with TypeScript, enough to build a usable demo or internal tool without waiting on someone else. Interest in the data foundations — data governance, semantic or ontology modelling, entitlements, or large-scale analytics products; automotive or mobility domain exposure is a plus. Evidence of building things for their own sake — open-source contributions, side projects, technical writing, or community involvement. This is a hybrid role with in-office expectations determined by location and subject to change based on evolving business needs. What’s In It For You Competitive compensation package, including base salary and incentive opportunities where applicable. Comprehensive health and wellness benefits for employees and eligible dependents. Retirement savings programs, including company matching contributions where available. Equal Opportunity Employer Mobility Global is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected, supported, and empowered to succeed. We provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process and employment for qualified individuals with disabilities. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and deploying intelligent AI applications using modern LLMs, agentic frameworks, vector databases, and cloud-based AI services. ## Key Responsibilities Design and develop Generative AI applications using LLMs such as GPT, Claude, Llama, or Gemini. Build and optimize RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, reranking, and retrieval optimization. Develop autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel. Implement tool calling, function calling, workflow orchestration, and multi-agent collaboration. Develop backend services and REST APIs using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask. Integrate LLM applications with enterprise systems, databases, APIs, and external tools. Work with vector databases such as FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, or Azure AI Search. Implement prompt engineering, context management, conversation memory, and response optimization. Evaluate and improve AI application quality, including accuracy, relevance, hallucination rates, latency, and cost. Implement security measures, guardrails, input validation, and protection against prompt injection. Deploy and maintain AI applications using Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms. Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders. ## Required Technical Skills **1. Generative AI & LLMs** Hands-on experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models. Knowledge of GPT, Claude, Llama, Gemini, or similar models. Prompt engineering, structured outputs, embeddings, and LLM API integration. **2. Agentic AI & Frameworks** Experience with at least one framework: LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel. Understanding of AI agents, tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and agent memory. Ability to build tool-using agents and multi-step AI workflows. **3. RAG & Vector Databases** Experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications. Document processing, chunking strategies, embedding models, semantic search, and hybrid retrieval. Familiarity with vector databases such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, or Azure AI Search. **4. Programming & Backend Development** Strong Python programming skills. Experience with FastAPI, Flask, REST APIs, and JSON. Working knowledge of SQL, Git, debugging, and software development best practices. **5. Cloud & Deployment** Exposure to AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, application deployment, and monitoring. Experience with Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, or Vertex AI is an advantage. **6. Evaluation & Responsible AI** Knowledge of LLM evaluation, hallucination reduction, and response quality assessment. Understanding of AI guardrails, data privacy, access control, and prompt-injection mitigation. Familiarity with tools such as LangSmith, RAGAS, or similar evaluation frameworks is preferred. ## Good to Have Experience with fine-tuning, LoRA/PEFT, or open-source LLMs. Knowledge of knowledge graphs, graph-based RAG, and advanced retrieval techniques. Experience with AI observability, tracing, and production monitoring. Familiarity with Kubernetes and scalable AI application architectures. Experience delivering enterprise-grade AI assistants, copilots, or automation solutions. ## Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline. ## Ideal Candidate Profile 4+ years of relevant software development, AI/ML, or Generative AI experience. Practical experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications. Strong Python skills and a solid understanding of RAG and agentic AI architectures. Ability to develop production-ready AI solutions and troubleshoot complex technical issues. Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills. ## Keywords for Candidate Sourcing Generative AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, LLM, Large Language Models, Python, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Prompt Engineering, Vector Database, Embeddings, FastAPI, GPT, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, AI Agents, Function Calling. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who works with agentic tooling every day and wants to ship production AI in a regulated, high-impact environment. Role Summary: As a Data Scientist/Engineer at Highmark, you will play a crucial role in building and deploying innovative native AI solutions that transform the US healthcare payer experience. You will leverage your expertise in data science, machine learning, and engineering principles to extract insights, develop robust models, and integrate them into scalable products. This role requires a proactive mindset, a passion for applying AI to complex healthcare challenges, and the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

AI Product Development Implementation: Design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms to solve specific business problems within the healthcare payer domain, contributing directly to native AI product development initiatives.

Data-Driven Insights for Healthcare: Perform in-depth data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in large, complex healthcare datasets, translating these insights into actionable recommendations for product enhancements and strategic decisions.

Model Deployment MLOps Support: Contribute to the operationalization of AI/ML models, working closely with MLOps and engineering teams to ensure models are deployed reliably, efficiently, and with appropriate monitoring within our cloud infrastructure.

Collaboration Communication: Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including Product Managers, other Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Software Engineers, and business stakeholders to understand requirements, refine solutions, and communicate results.

Proactive Problem Solving: Proactively identify opportunities where AI/ML can drive value, suggest innovative approaches, and contribute to the evolution of our AI capabilities within the payer landscape.

Continuous Learning Adaptation: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in AI, Generative AI, and healthcare technology, actively exploring and applying new techniques to enhance our product offerings.

Essential Responsibilities
AI/ML Model Development: Develop, validate, and refine machine learning models (e.g., predictive, prescriptive, generative) using robust statistical and computational methods, specifically addressing challenges in claims, member engagement, provider management, or clinical operations.
Data Acquisition Feature Engineering: Work with large, diverse healthcare datasets (e.g., claims, clinical, eligibility, provider data) to perform data cleaning, transformation, and sophisticated feature engineering to prepare data for model training.

Minimum 2-3 years directly applying data science methodologies to build and deploy solutions within the US healthcare payer or provider domain.

Healthcare Payer Domain (Core): Solid understanding of key healthcare payer concepts, data types (e.g., claims, eligibility, clinical codes like ICD/CPT), operational processes, and regulatory requirements (e.g., HIPAA, HITECH).
AI Product Development Mindset: Demonstrated ability to think proactively about how AI/ML can be integrated into products, understand user needs, and contribute to the end-to-end development of AI-driven features.
Digital Acumen: Experience working with digital products or platforms, understanding API integrations, and contributing to scalable, production-ready solutions.

Stakeholder Empathy: Strong ability to listen to and understand business challenges, translate them into data science problems, and provide solutions that resonate with stakeholder needs.

Continuous Learning: A strong interest in applied research and development, a passion for exploring new concepts (especially in Generative AI), and a commitment to continuous learning within the rapidly evolving field of AI in healthcare.

n191026012258.title: Agentic AI Engineer
n191026012258.description:
Position: AI Engineer Agentic AI Developer
Location: Pan India
Total Exp: 6 to 9 Yrs

Role purpose

To take a business problem inside client health, wealth and career operations and deliver the agentic application that solves it. End to end: sit with the team, shape the solution, build it, ship it, instrument it, and stay with it while people come to depend on it. The output of this role is running software in daily use, not a specification. It is a hands-on role, and the expectation is that you are in the codebase every day.

Key responsibilities

Discovery and solution shaping

•   Sit in the business team's working sessions, watch the process as it actually runs, and record where the time, the errors and the rework go.

•   Turn what you heard into a buildable design within days rather than weeks, and walk the agent owner and the business lead through it before you write code.

•   Own the architecture decisions: the agent's tools and boundaries, where state lives, how it authenticates, what it does when a model call fails or a tool returns nonsense.

•   Write down the options you rejected and why, because that record is what stops the design being reopened three months later.

•   Say plainly what cannot be delivered in the window available, and propose the smaller thing that can.

Build and delivery

•   Write the production code for the agent: prompts held under version control, tool definitions, orchestration, retries, fallbacks, and the retrieval or context layer it depends on.

•   Build the agent-facing front end so a colleague can see what the agent did, understand why, and correct it without calling you.

•   Build the services, APIs and integration layers behind it, and the integration into the systems of record.

•   Raise pull requests small enough to be reviewed properly, review other people's, and keep the pipeline green.

•   Ship into the client environment with identity, access, secret handling and data residency done correctly the first time.

•   Demonstrate working software to the business team on a regular cadence through the build, not at the end of it.

Retrieval, context and the agent's knowledge

•   Design the retrieval layer properly: chunking that respects document structure, hybrid keyword and vector search, reranking, and citations the user can check.

•   Choose the embedding model and the index, and own the consequences: dimensionality against cost, refresh cadence, and what happens when the index goes stale.

•   Know when retrieval is the wrong answer and a query against the system of record, or a deterministic tool, is the right one.

•   Engineer the context budget: what goes in the window, what gets summarised, what is remembered between turns, and where prompt caching earns its keep.

Evaluation, instrumentation and operability

•   Build the offline golden set alongside the agent, from real cases rather than invented ones, and gate every change on it in the pipeline.

•   Build LLM-as-judge scoring where human review will not scale, calibrate the rubric against human scores, and re-check that agreement rather than trusting the judge.

•   Measure retrieval separately from generation, so a bad answer is traced to the chunk it missed rather than blamed on the model.

•   Instrument every agent run with distributed tracing: inputs, tool calls, retrieved context, decisions, latency, token cost and outcome.

•   Watch live traces in the days after a release, find the failure modes, and record each one with the guardrail you added against it.

•   Run shadow or canary releases for anything that touches a live process, and set the alerting that tells us an agent has drifted before the business team does.

•   Report quality against the acceptance criteria the agent owner set, honestly, including the misses.

Guardrails, cost and model choice

•   Build the input and output guardrails: PII handling, prompt injection resistance, grounding and citation checks, and a clean escalation path when the agent should refuse.

•   Choose models on measured evidence, route between them where a smaller one suffices, and report cost per resolved task rather than cost per token.

•   Know the difference between a prompt problem, a retrieval problem, a tooling problem and a model problem, and fix the right one.

Data and integration

•   Model the business domain in the design rather than bending the business to a convenient schema.

•   Profile the data before you trust it, and tell the agent owner when the process depends on a field that is half empty.

•   Test integrations against production-shaped data, including the malformed records nobody mentioned in the workshop.

Handover and reuse

•   Document the build so another engineer can take it on without you, and keep that document current.

•   Turn what you built twice into something the team can reuse, and tell the team it exists.

•   Raise risk early, in plain terms, to the technology lead.

Role & responsibilities

Job Description: AI Engineer Agentic AI Development

Job Title: AI Engineer – Agentic AI Development
Experience: 6–8+ years overall experience (4–6+ years in AI development preferred)
Primary Skills: Agentic AI, Python, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Vertex AI, Google ADK, AI Evaluation

Project Overview

The project focuses on developing an enterprise-grade Agentic AI platform that leverages specialized Large Language Model (LLM) agents, orchestrated through an Agent Development Kit (ADK), to automate data retrieval, multi-step reasoning, hypothesis validation, and complex decision-making.

The platform incorporates Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) mechanisms to ensure autonomous agent actions align with organizational safety, accuracy, and compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities

Build and manage sequential, parallel, and loop-based agent workflows for complex reasoning and automated data processing.

Implement advanced agent reasoning patterns, including ReAct, Chain-of-Thought (CoT), and self-reflection, to improve output reliability.
Develop and deploy AI agents and agent-based applications using Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Vertex AI.

Overview:

TekWissen Group is a workforce management provider operating throughout India and several other countries worldwide. The client below is a leading technology company offering a range of IT solutions tbusinesses and organizations, enabling them ttransform their digital futures




Position: Consultant, IT Architecture

Location: Bangalore

Job Type: Contract

Work Type: Onsite




Job Description:

We are seeking a Senior Principal Engineer to build the AI-native capabilities that replace how security work is performed today.
Security processes today run across multiple functional teams, frequently duplicated with different tooling and different definitions of done. This role re-engineers and implements the rationalized version of those processes as AI-native workflows, working from an approved solution design and directly with the teams whose work is being agentified.
The expectation is production-grade engineering. Systems are delivered tested, instrumented so that the agent operations team can monitor them, and documented sufficiently for another engineer to extend them. Defects found in production are resolved by this role at root cause.

Objectives of This Role

Cross-functional security workflows delivered as working AI-native implementations that replace the manual and fragmented processes they came from
One implementation serving every function that shares a process, preserving in the build the consolidation the design sets out
Delivery on committed timelines, with the reliability, observability, and cost profile to run in production
Reusable components and patterns, so each workflow after the first starts from existing code

Responsibilities:

Build the AI-native implementation of security workflows from approved solution designs, including agent loops where an agent is the right pattern, tool and service implementations, sub-agent orchestration, state and checkpoint handling, and the deterministic components that own gating and verdict logic
Work directly with the functional owners and practitioners whose process is being agentified to establish the operational detail a solution design does not carry: real data sources, exception paths, edge cases, and current decision logic
Re-engineer the process as part of implementing it, rather than reproducing it step for step: remove steps that exist only because the work was performed by hand, collapse handoffs and queues, and restructure sequence and timing where agentic execution changes what is possible
Implement the consolidated workflow so that every function sharing the process is served by one build, rather than forking the implementation per team
Implement context strategy in code: retrieval and search, memory, grounding against enterprise data sources, prompt assembly, schema-constrained output, and context budgeting under real payload sizes
Build tool and integration surfaces against the systems each function already works in, including MCP servers, API clients, and event consumers, with scoped credentials, rate limiting, retries, backpressure, and idempotency for actions that cannot safely repeat
Implement automated tests, validate agent behavior against the acceptance criteria defined for the workflow, and hold to code review, typed interfaces, dependency hygiene, and documentation sufficient for another engineer to extend the system
Instrument systems for operations, providing execution traces spanning agent steps and tool calls, token and cost accounting, and latency measurement that the agent operations team can monitor against
Engineer for cost and latency through prompt and response caching, model selection and routing with fallback, and context compaction, with measurement to confirm the effect
Harden systems against adversarial input, including prompt injection through retrieved or user-supplied content, tool abuse, and unintended data movement through agent surfaces
Resolve defects escalated from agent operations, including non-deterministic behavior and degradation that surfaces only under production load, fixing at root cause with regression coverage that prevents recurrence
Validate the delivered workflow with the functional owners before release, deliver within committed windows, and raise design gaps to the solution owner rather than resolving them unilaterally in code

Required Skills and Qualifications:

12+ years in software engineering with direct ownership of systems in production
Agentic systems you personally built and shipped into production, not prototypes, notebooks, or proofs of concept
Strong programming proficiency in Python and at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or an equivalent language, with demonstrable code quality practice covering testing, review, refactoring, and maintainability
Hands-on implementation experience across:
Agent loops and tool calling: loop control, sub-agent delegation, state management and checkpointing, and idempotent handling of consequential actions
Context engineering: retrieval and search, memory, grounding in enterprise data, prompt assembly, and structured or schema-constrained output
Testing and validation: automated tests for behavior that varies between runs, regression suites, and validation against defined acceptance criteria
Cost and latency engineering: token accounting, prompt and response caching, model routing with fallback, and context compaction
Process re-engineering experience: analyzing an existing workflow and rebuilding it around what automation makes possible, rather than encoding current practice into software
Experience replacing an existing manual or fragmented business process with software, working directly with the people who perform that process today
Integration engineering: REST and GraphQL APIs, event-driven consumers, OAuth and scoped credential handling, schema and contract versioning, and resilient behavior under partial failure
Observability and delivery engineering: structured logging, distributed tracing, and metrics for systems whose behavior varies between runs, plus CI/CD pipelines, automated quality gates, and containerized deployment
Ability to work independently from written specification, deliver against committed timelines, and communicate progress and blockers without prompting
Bachelors or masters degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Skills and Qualifications:

Experience applying AI within a security domain such as application security, DevSecOps, vulnerability management, code analysis, or software supply-chain security
Experience building MCP servers or agent tooling, or extending AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor
Working knowledge of agentic frameworks and orchestration libraries, and judgment about when to use them
Experience with LLMOps in production, covering versioning, staged rollout, and regression detection
Familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and with secure development practice
Experience ramping quickly onto an unfamiliar codebase and becoming productive in it

Mandatory Skills:

Technical Skills: Python, LangGraph, LangFuse, LLM must haves + Typescript/JavaScript. Hands on Production based Implementation experience is mandate.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.


Job Overview

About TE Connectivity & the Channel BU
TE Connectivity is a global technology leader that designs and manufactures connectivity and sensor solutions, serving industries that are transforming the future. The Channel Business Unit (CBU) manages TE''s global distribution network and plays a critical role in driving growth, enhancing customer experience, and enabling commercial excellence across 300+ distributor partners worldwide. Channel BU brings together Sales Enablement, Marketing, Pricing, Customer Service, Digital, and PMO functions to accelerate revenue, deliver digitally enabled experiences, and achieve above-market growth.
Role Definition
We are seeking a skilled and motivated Data Scientist & AI Developer to join our India-based analytics team supporting the Channel Business Unit. This individual contributor role is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying AI/ML models, data science solutions, and intelligent automation capabilities that drive measurable business impact across Channel operations, including sales forecasting, POS match-rate optimization, customer segmentation, pricing intelligence, NLP-based automation, and agentic AI solutions.
The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth in machine learning, statistical modeling, and software engineering with the ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, translating complex business problems into actionable AI-driven solutions. This role requires a self-starter who can independently manage the full data science lifecycle, from problem framing and exploratory data analysis through model development, validation, deployment, and monitoring, while contributing to a culture of innovation and continuous learning.
Based in Bangalore, India, this role will report to the India-based Data Analytics & Data Science Delivery Manager and partner closely with the NA-based Data & Analytics product owner, Channel AI Principal, Channel BU leadership, global DIA teams, and cross-functional stakeholders across AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions.


Tasks and Responsibilities

AI/ML Model Development & Deployment
Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and statistical models for key business use cases including forecasting, customer segmentation, pricing optimization, automation, cross-sell, and churn prediction.
Perform exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and data preparation using diverse enterprise data sources.
Build and maintain scalable ML pipelines using Databricks, MLflow, and cloud technologies for training, deployment, monitoring, and model lifecycle management.
Develop NLP solutions such as text classification, entity extraction, sentiment analysis, and summarization to enhance business processes.
Implement model governance practices including versioning, A/B testing, drift monitoring, retraining, and documentation.
Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation
Design and develop agentic AI solutions, conversational AI experiences, and intelligent automation workflows that improve business access to data and insights.
Evaluate and apply emerging AI technologies including LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, and cognitive automation across business functions.
Build and scale AI proof-of-concepts from ideation through production deployment.
Partner with AI leadership to assess technologies and recommend solutions aligned with business priorities.
Data Engineering & Platform Enablement
Develop SQL and Python-based ETL/ELT processes supporting analytics and AI/ML development on the Databricks platform.
Build and maintain curated datasets, feature stores, and data assets that accelerate model development and reuse.
Collaborate with data engineering and governance teams to ensure data quality, lineage, security, and compliance.
Support migration and modernization of analytics and data science solutions onto Databricks.
Business Partnership & Insight Delivery
Work closely with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Care, Pricing, and Strategy to identify opportunities and deliver data science solutions with measurable business impact.
Translate analytical results into actionable insights through data storytelling, visualizations, and executive-ready presentations.
Present recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences and support adoption of AI-driven solutions.
Contribute to business case development, feasibility assessments, and value estimation for new AI initiatives.
Responsible AI & Continuous Learning
Ensure AI/ML solutions comply with enterprise standards for responsible AI, privacy, governance, bias mitigation, and regulatory requirements.
Develop KPIs and monitoring frameworks to track model performance, adoption, and business value.
Stay current on AI/ML advancements and share knowledge through mentoring, documentation, reviews, and community engagement.
Contribute reusable best practices, frameworks, and lessons learned to strengthen team capabilities.


What your background should look like:

Design, develop, and deploy production-ready AI-powered applications, agent workflows, and LLM-based solutions.

Join Visa and do work that matters to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Overview:




Corporate Reliability Engineering is advancing an engineering-first model focused on reliability, automation, quality, security, and proactive operations. This hands-on I5 role will work directly with Core Infrastructure, Oracle Database, Network, Security, and adjacent engineering and operations teams to design, build, test, deploy, and support secure AI, agentic automation, API, and reliability solutions across enterprise Windows, Linux/Unix, Oracle Database and Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), and Network environments.

The engineer will convert recurring operational issues into maintainable, auditable, and production-ready solutions that reduce manual effort, accelerate diagnosis and resolution, strengthen service resilience, and deliver measurable operational outcomes.




Key Responsibilities:



Design and deliver AI/ML applications, LLM-enabled solutions, RAG, agentic workflows, automation frameworks, APIs, integrations, and reusable engineering components.
Build intelligent capabilities for incident triage, knowledge retrieval, service-health analysis, root-cause investigation, remediation recommendations, and approved automated execution.
Automate workflows across Windows, Linux/Unix, Oracle Database/EBS, and Network operations through scripting, orchestration, event-driven patterns, and secure API integrations.
Integrate with approved enterprise ticketing, monitoring, CMDB, knowledge, database, collaboration, source-control, and deployment platforms
Engineer for reliability through testing, exception handling, rollback, observability, telemetry, runbooks, support models, operational handoff, and measurable service outcomes.

Combine strong technical depth with professionalism, humility, adaptability, accountability, and sound judgment when leading discussions or responding to operational challenges.
Communicate technical concepts, risks, design choices, and business impacts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Apply secure coding and participate in code review, security assessment, dependency and open-source review, vulnerability remediation, security testing, and required release approvals before production promotion.
Protect Visa information according to its classification and approved handling requirements. Use approved platforms and data sources, enforce least-privilege access, protect credentials and secrets, and prevent unauthorized disclosure, modification, retention, or transmission.
Implement traceability through authenticated access, change records, version control, event logging, monitoring, evidence retention, documented ownership, and support procedures.
Apply Visa AI governance requirements across the lifecycle, including defined ownership, risk assessment, data-use review, validation, ongoing monitoring, documented limitations, escalation paths, and controlled retirement or material change.
Design human oversight and approval gates appropriate to risk. Automated actions must remain within approved permissions and guardrails, with safe failure handling, rollback, and manual intervention paths.
Validate generative and agentic AI solutions for quality, reliability, security, privacy, information integrity, and operational risk; document evaluation methods, acceptance criteria, evidence, limitations, and monitoring.
Escalate security incidents, privacy concerns, control gaps, model risks, unexpected AI behavior, and policy exceptions through approved Visa processes.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
At least 5 years of professional experience in software development, automation engineering, AI/ML engineering, agentic systems, reliability engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles.
Hands-on experience using Claude Code, GitHub, Copilot, Power automate
Hands-on experience developing maintainable applications, scripts, APIs, integrations, automations, or workflow-based solutions in enterprise IT environments.
Proficiency in Python and one or more of PowerShell, Bash, or JavaScript/TypeScript, plus experience with Git, testing, debugging, APIs, and CI/CD.
Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings/vector search, agent frameworks, tools or function calling, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, technical judgment, ownership, adaptability, and clear written and verbal communication.
Experience integrating with ServiceNow, Jira, GitHub, Azure DevOps, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, monitoring platforms, or enterprise support data.
Experience in reliability engineering, incident and problem management, root-cause analysis, operational automation, release validation, or controlled deployment.
Ability to define measurable outcomes such as reduced manual effort, higher automation success, faster analysis, fewer repeat issues, stronger traceability, and improved service reliability.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. n191026911131.title: LLM & Agentic AI Performance Engineer
n191026911131.description:
Job Details:

Job Description: The Role and Impact:


Join Intel's Data Center AI organization and help shape how LLM and Agentic AI workloads perform on Intel platforms.

Our team operates at a unique intersection of core performance optimization, AI frameworks, and customer-facing AI solutions. We bridge the gap between teams that deeply understand silicon and benchmarking and teams building real-world AI solutions, turning performance insights into software optimizations that developers and customers can use.

In this role, you will own end-to-end performance characterization and optimization of LLM and Agentic AI workloads, from Python-level frameworks and inference runtimes down to Linux, system architecture, and hardware performance counters.

This is not simply a benchmarking role. Benchmarking tells us what the number is. Your job is to understand why the number is what it is, identify the hardware or software bottleneck, and determine what needs to change to remove it.

Your work will translate into code contributions, framework optimizations, best-known configurations (BKCs), customer-ready solutions, and insights that help influence future Intel hardware and software.

If you enjoy working across the complete AI stack, from agent frameworks and LLM serving engines to NUMA, memory bandwidth, cache behavior, and silicon counters, this role provides an opportunity to work at that intersection.


About the Team:


The AI Solutions and Toolkit Engineering team is part of Intel's Data Center organization, focused on enabling modern AI workloads and solutions on Intel platforms.

We work across the AI ecosystem, collaborating with AI framework and runtime developers, performance and optimization teams, hardware architects, open-source communities, and solution engineering teams.

Our goal is to take deep platform capabilities and performance insights and translate them into practical, optimized AI solutions that developers and customers can deploy.

n261026501738.title: Senior AI Engineer
n261026501738.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior AI Engineer

Mastercards Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
Were looking for a Senior AI Engineer, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. In this hands-on role, youll design, build, and ship production-grade agentic AI systems. These include agents that make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs, handle complex multi-step workflows, and deliver secure, scalable, reliable results. Youll work across agent orchestration, tool calling, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps, help set the engineering standard for Gen AI development, and mentor other engineers on the team. Much of this work is strong backend engineering. If you bring deep experience building production services and have started building with LLMs, wed love to

Roles & Responsibilities
- Architect and build the tool-calling layer that powers our agents: wrap internal services, data platforms, and external APIs as well-defined tools with clear schemas, contracts, and permissions.
- Engineer reliable tool execution at scale, including parallel and chained tool calls, timeouts, retries, idempotency, error recovery, and graceful handling of tool failures or bad model outputs.
- Develop high-performance Python backend services for LLM orchestration, covering async job handling, streaming responses, caching, rate limiting, and distributed workflows supporting high-throughput Gen AI operations.
- Engineer state, memory, and context management subsystems so agents can maintain session continuity across long, multi-step, tool-heavy interactions.
- Architect multi-agent and skills-based agent systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar, enabling autonomous reasoning, tool use, inter-agent coordination, and adaptive decision-making at enterprise scale.
- Build observability for agent behavior, including end-to-end tracing of tool calls, measuring tool-selection accuracy, and debugging multi-step agent runs in production.
- Build retrieval systems (RAG and Graph-RAG) where agents need grounded knowledge, using vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
- Establish LLMOps and MLOps pipelines on Databricks (AWS), covering MLflow, prompt and agent evaluation, model lineage tracking, CI/CD, and monitoring.
- Design multimodal generative AI pipelines that unify text, image, tabular, and graph data using modern transformer-based and foundation models.
- Guide fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and alignment strategies (e.g., PEFT, LoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF) to adapt foundation models for specialized enterprise use cases, working closely with ML specialists.
- Implement Responsible AI practices, including hallucination mitigation, bias detection, output safety guardrails, explainability, and compliance with data ethics standards.
- Evaluate and productionize advances in agentic AI, multimodal models, and frontier foundation models, benchmarking them against enterprise performance and safety requirements.
- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, and set the engineering standard for Gen AI development across the program.
All About You
- Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
- A strong track record of building and operating production backend systems at scale, including distributed services, APIs, async processing, data stores, and observability.
- Strong API design and integration experience: you know how to build services that other systems, and now LLMs, can call safely and reliably.
- Excellent Python engineering skills, including async programming, API development (FastAPI or similar), and microservices, plus SQL proficiency.
- Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM-powered application to production that uses tool/function calling, such as agents that call APIs, query databases, or trigger workflows. This can be with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models.
- A working understanding of Gen AI engineering patterns, such as prompt design, embeddings, semantic search, and agent memory, or a demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on new technical domains.
- Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome).
- Experience leading or mentoring engineers, plus strong communication and stakeholder management skills. You should be able to translate technical work into business value.
- Nice to have: experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or building tool servers and connectors for LLM agents.
- Nice to have: experience evaluating agent performance, such as tool-selection accuracy, task completion rates, or multi-step reasoning reliability.
- Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, knowledge graphs, or MLOps tooling like MLflow, Weights & Biases, SageMaker, or Bedrock.
- Coming from a backend background We value engineers who take AI from prototype to production as much as those who train the models. If youve built high-throughput systems and started applying those skills to LLM-powered products, we want to hear from you, even if you havent worked with every tool listed here

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard s security policies and practices;

Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard s guidelines.

You will set technical direction and lead end-to-end AI solutions across matching, multimodal retrieval, ranking, computer vision, vision-language modeling, and GenAI-powered experiences from problem framing and research through deployment, evaluation, and iteration at scale. Product matching and entity resolution
Semantic, visual, and multimodal retrieval
Search relevance, ranking, re-ranking, and recommendation
Image classification, detection, segmentation, similarity, visual attribute extraction, and content understanding

n251026004455.title: IICS Developer (CAI and CDI)
n251026004455.description:
Introduction

Our goal at Pivotree is to help accelerate the future of frictionless commerce. We will help lead this

change over the next decade because we believe a future where technology is embedded intimately

into all aspects of our everyday lives can benefit everyone and will shape the interactions with the

brands we love. We will help shape the future of frictionless commerce by working together with

some of the best brands in the world and some of the best people in the industry to leverage

converging technologies that will make it possible to accelerate frictionless commerce faster than

ever.

Pivotree provides services focused on the design, implementation, management, and maintenance

of complex ecommerce solutions for large enterprises. We provide the technical skills necessary to

enable the effective use of technologies combined with the business context to leverage a solution to

solve our clients' business challenges. We strive to fill the gaps in available technology with our own

IP to reduce the barriers to adoption.

We enable inclusive, immersive and highly personalized experiences for our clients and their

customers. We build our products with a view to productizing and scaling technology to lower the

costs and reduce the risks of implementing and managing our integrated solutions. This is a journey

of technology acceleration combined with consumer readiness and adoption. We are looking for

people capable of adapting relentlessly to the rapidly evolving world around us.

Position Summary

As a market leader in product data content solutions, Pivotree helps clients assess, implement, and

run best-of-breed applications for Master Data Management (MDM) and Product Information

Management (PIM). We are looking for an IICS Developer who will design, build, and support

integration pipelines that collect, transform, and manage product and enterprise data across cloud

applications, databases, and data platforms. This role uses AI tools as part of day-to-day

engineering work, under clear standards for quality, data handling, and review.

Roles & Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain Informatica PowerCenter and Informatica Intelligent Cloud

Services (IICS) solutions that deliver scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise data

integration.

Develop and optimize mappings, workflows, reusable transformations, expressions, stored

procedures, and ETL pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and loading data into data

warehouses, data lakes, and operational systems.

Build and support complex integration patterns, including incremental and delta loads, Slowly

Changing Dimensions (SCD Types 1 and 2), star schema loads, and large-scale batch and

near-real-time processing.

Build and maintain REST and web service integrations, service connectors, business services,

and IICS Application Integration (CAI) processes and process objects for real-time integration

with Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, Workday, and other on-premises and cloud platforms.

Install and configure add-on connectors and drivers for IICS; build file-watching and file-

transfer scripts (SFTP and similar) for scheduled and event-driven data exchange.

Optimize SQL performance, database connectivity, task scheduling, and cloud-native

deployments on Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, and Google BigQuery, using AI-generated




performance recommendations only after validating them against execution plans and load

metrics.

Implement data quality checks, governance controls, metadata management, lineage, and

impact analysis to keep enterprise data accurate, compliant, and trusted.

Troubleshoot ETL, integration, and pipeline issues, using AI-assisted root cause analysis to

isolate performance bottlenecks, transformation errors, and data quality anomalies. Validate

every AI-suggested fix against logs, sample data, and execution plans before it reaches

production.

Use approved AI tools across the development lifecycle to draft and review mapping logic,

SQL, test data, and technical documentation, and to summarize job logs. Follow Pivotree's AI

usage policy at all times, including rules on client and customer data, and record where AI

contributed to each change.

Contribute to AI-enabled data enrichment use cases, such as attribute extraction,

categorization, and content normalization for PIM, as the project roadmap requires.

Collaborate with data architects, business analysts, and cross-functional teams to design

integration architectures, document reusable patterns and guidelines for enterprise

applications, and continuously improve data management processes.

Communicate project status clearly to management and stakeholders.

Technical Skills

IICS Cloud Data Integration (CDI) and Cloud Application Integration (CAI), 3+ years hands-on:

mappings, mapping tasks, task flows, schedules, parameter files, transformations (Expression,

Router, Filter, Lookup, Update Strategy, Union, Aggregator, Joiner, Sorter), CAI processes,

service connectors, and process objects.

Informatica PowerCenter, 5+ years hands-on: mappings, workflows, reusable transformations,

stored procedures, and session tuning.

Advanced SQL on Oracle and SQL Server: complex joins, analytic functions, query tuning, and

DDL generation; plus Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, or Google BigQuery loading and

performance tuning (preferred).

REST APIs and web services with JSON and XML payloads, including authentication, error

handling, and integrations with Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, or Workday.

Data warehousing and modeling: star schemas, SCD Types 1 and 2, incremental loads,

conceptual, logical, and physical data models, and data quality and lineage tooling.

File processing and scripting: flat files (CSV, delimited, XML), file-watching and SFTP transfer

scripts, Unix/Linux shell or DOS scripting, Python for validation and API work (preferred), and

installing IICS add-on connectors and drivers.

Version control and deployment: Git, IICS asset management, and promotion across

development, test, and production environments.

AI-assisted development: working fluency with an approved AI assistant for SQL, mapping

logic, scripts, and documentation; verifying AI output against sample data and execution plans;

keeping client data out of unapproved tools; and building or supporting LLM-based pipeline

steps such as enrichment or classification with evaluation and cost monitoring (preferred).

Key Competencies

Ability to learn new technology quickly and adapt to changes in tooling and platforms.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with a systematic approach to root cause analysis.
Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences.


Commitment to documentation, reusable design patterns, and engineering best practices.
Ownership of quality: willingness to challenge assumptions, including AI-generated ones,

before they reach production.




Pivotree is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive

and accessible workplace.

n261026009267.description:
Job Title: Senior Data Scientist AI/GenAI, LLM Evaluation & Strategy
Location: Onsite – Bengaluru
Employment: Full Time with VDart Digital




Key Responsibilities:

Use case definition: Translate business requirements into clearly defined AI and GenAI use cases and task types, such as classification, extraction, summarization, retrieval augmented generation (RAG) and recommendation. Judge where an agent adds value and where traditional machine learning is the better fit.
Baseline and success metrics: Define the baseline business and operational metrics the AI solution is expected to improve, and connect model metrics directly to those business outcomes before any build begins.
Evaluation dataset: Establish a curated evaluation dataset before implementation, including edge cases and adversarial examples, with a clear labeling approach and ground truth.
Exploratory data analysis: Develop and execute the EDA strategy and sampling approach, covering data quality, representativeness and early detection of data leakage. Analyze the findings and recommend how they should guide solution design.
Design of experiments: Create the design of experiments (DOE), the formal plan for testing which approach works best, including hypotheses, factors and levels, experiment metrics, evaluation methodology and decision criteria agreed before the experiment runs.
TC2 ownership: Lead and own all data science deliverables and artifacts required for TC2 readiness and approval.
TC3 accountability: Serve as the accountable data science lead through TC3, validating proof of concept execution against the approved DOE, evaluation criteria and acceptance thresholds, and providing the technical recommendation on whether to progress to a minimum viable product (MVP).
Production readiness: Ensure designs handed to the delivery team are fully executable and will not break in production, and act as the point of contact for data or model issues during implementation and after go-live.



Required Qualifications:

Experience: 7 or more years of hands-on data science experience, including personal ownership of methodology design on complex AI projects from scoping through delivery.
LLM and agent evaluation: Proven experience evaluating LLM and agentic systems beyond accuracy, including building ground truth test sets and measuring routing and tool call correctness, groundedness, faithfulness, completeness, hallucination rates and end to end task success.
Experiment design and statistics: Strong grounding in experiment design and statistics, including comparing models or prompt versions on small labeled datasets, accounting for run to run variability, and setting acceptance thresholds in advance.
Machine learning and GenAI depth: Deep hands-on experience with classic machine learning (classification, regression, time series) and with GenAI, including RAG, agent frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph, and prompt engineering.
Production awareness: Practical understanding of MLOps and production deployment, sufficient to design solutions that a separate engineering team can implement reliably.
Stakeholder leadership: Demonstrated ability to shape scope with business stakeholders, push back with data, explain design trade-offs, and present recommendations at approval gates without needing close direction.



Preferred Qualifications:

Industrial domain: Experience in energy, power generation, manufacturing or other industrial settings, particularly with sensor, time series or maintenance data.
Advanced degree: A master’s degree or PhD in data science, statistics, applied mathematics or a related quantitative field.
Mentoring: Experience guiding or mentoring other data scientists on methodology and evaluation practice.
